items.headline: Shopify Migrates Shop App from React Native to Native Swift/Kotlin in 12 Weeks with AI Agents
bullets: Shop app rebuilt fully native (Swift/Kotlin) from proof-of-concept to published in 12 weeks with six engineers plus AI coding agents
New architecture (Helix) decouples business logic via CLI—agents test changes in milliseconds without opening slow simulators, enabling continuous checkpoint-validated rewrites
Results: Android cold startup +50% faster, crash rate -90%, app size reduced 109MB; main Shopify app (300+ screens) now underway, full fleet follow
items.novelty: Shopify reversed its 2020 bet on React Native six years in, pivoting entirely to native because AI agents made the cost of building twice cheaper than maintaining a shared codebase—the first major platform company to operationalize agent-driven architecture at scale.

items.headline: DeepSeek Releases V4.1-Flash, Retires V4-Pro via Automatic Routing at Lower Cost
bullets: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash on September 10 as 552B-parameter multimodal MoE with native image understanding, 8B active on input/16B on output
From September 14, all deepseek-v4-pro API requests route to V4.1-Flash at Flash prices (11–57% cheaper depending on token type) until V4.1-Pro ships
Open weights published under MIT on Hugging Face; model outperforms V4-Pro on performance, cost, speed, and latency according to internal/external testing
items.novelty: DeepSeek shipped a smaller, cheaper model that operationally replaces its flagship in production, signaling a shift in how frontier labs handle model deprecation and the viability of mixture-of-experts for both capability and cost efficiency.

items.headline: Bay Area Weather: Clear skies with cooler temperatures; relief from multi-day heat wave
bullets: Friday temperatures dropping from Thursday's 90s–100s to just the 80s at warmest, with continued clear conditions
Heat Advisory from prior days expiring; coast and inland both seeing relief as cooling trend establishes through weekend
Saturday forecast shows further cooling to mostly 70s across Bay Area, including inland
items.novelty: Heat relief arrived on schedule Friday after a sustained high-temperature period; weekend will stay cool.
